mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 0 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 11, low 0.

A gun attack in Krakow killed at least six people and injured around fifteen, prompting Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk to declare two days of national mourning.

Kosovo's foreign minister Glauk Konjufca condemned the Krakow assault, saying Kosovo stands in solidarity with the Polish people.

Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez asserted that Spain is governed from within the country, not by Washington, Tel Aviv, Buenos Aires or Moscow.

Dana White announced that heavyweight champion Tyson Fury may be forced to withdraw from his upcoming bout with Anthony Joshua because of a newly disclosed injury.

Albanian residents of Preshevo in Serbia returned to the polls on Sunday, hoping their votes will influence the parliamentary election results after a joint campaign against Aleksandar Vučić.
